root_cause_analysis.diagnosis: Process-to-air temperature differential ΔT is 7.7K (<8.6K critical limit) at rotational speed 1,280 RPM. Thermal dissipation capacity has degraded by 64% due to coolant delivery restriction and heat exchanger airflow fouling, leading to exponential bearing thermal runaway.

recommended_maintenance_actions: Execute Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocol on Machine M08.
Verify spindle cooling jacket circulation flow rate and flush particulate buildup from coolant nozzles.
Inspect air filtration plenum and clean intake louvers.
Verify PT100 temperature sensor calibration against thermal imaging reference.
Perform automated post-service diagnostic cycle before returning machine to active production line.
